_scope_note: Runtime-ladder arm. Same families, same budget 64 per tunable family and the same two privileged teachers as the main campaign, so the oracle-versus-search gap is measured the same way at every runtime and the only thing that moves is the runtime. max_steps is raised because a schedule at runtime 108 is nine times flatter than at 12 and the integrator has to follow it for nine times as long; leaving it at 16384 would abort the long-runtime arm and look like a physics result.
